problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Given the matrix $A$ above, evaluate the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}^{T}\,Ay$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -3\end{aligned}].$

feedback.problem:
Consider the bilinear form $B(x,y),$ given by 

$$
B(x,y)=2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-4{x}_{2}{y}_{3}+{x}_{3}{y}_{1}-3{x}_{3}{y}_{2}.
$$

 

Evaluate $B(x,y)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\,$ $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2} \\ {y}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}].$ 

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-4{x}_{2}{y}_{3}+{x}_{3}{y}_{1}-3{x}_{3}{y}_{2} \\  & =2\cdot (-2)\cdot 0-4\cdot 2\cdot 3+(-1)\cdot 1-3\cdot (-1)\cdot 0 \\  & =0-24-1-0 \\  & =-25.\end{aligned}
$$
